title: Ordering Lunch for Different Needs
text: Mia: Hi, I'm Mia. I want lunch for my family. Tom: Hello. What do you need? Mia: My son likes noodles, but he cannot eat eggs. Tom: OK. Noodles, no eggs. And your daughter? Mia: She likes rice. She can eat eggs. Tom: Rice with eggs. Does she like vegetables? Mia: No, she doesn't. Tom: And you? Mia: I like soup. I can eat chicken. Tom: Chicken soup. Does your husband like soup? Mia: No, he doesn't. He likes bread and cheese. Tom: Bread and cheese. One more thing: does he eat fish? Mia: Yes, he does. But he cannot eat nuts. Tom: OK. No nuts. Your lunch is ready soon.

questions.prompt: What can Mia's son NOT eat?
What can Mia's husband NOT eat? Use ONE WORD from the conversation.
